title: The documentation for `rpc_config` is inconsistent with its actual behavior.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.7.dev3.official [60fff00a6]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev3 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 47.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_node.html#class-node-method-rpc-config

`void rpc_config(method: StringName, config: Variant)` 

> Changes the RPC configuration for the given method. config should either be null to disable the feature (as by default), or a [Dictionary](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_dictionary.html#class-dictionary) containing the following entries:

The description suggests this method can let users override the RPC configuration defined in the script (set via `@rpc`, get via `script->get_rpc_config()`).
But in reality, script-defined RPC config takes precedence over config set via `rpc_config()` (get via `get_node_rpc_config()`)
when the same method is configured in both places, as you can see here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/06c3946e3501a7f52a10eed96d200b93df17d373/modules/multiplayer/scene_rpc_interface.cpp#L105-L117
